worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.summary: An electrified charge: gather the current over your body, smash straight in and drive it into the target (a chance to paralyze). The circuit hurts you too, and being soaked leaks harder. Take Down, live-wired.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.description: The charge deals %1$s contact Electric damage, dashing up to %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick with a %4$s block collision radius.
A hit has a %1$s%% chance to paralyze; the user takes %2$s%% of the actual damage as recoil and shoves the target %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.overload.on: Overload: the current runs wide open - power, paralysis chance, knockback and sparks all rise, but the recoil is heavier and the wind-up longer.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.overload.of: Governed: lower power and recoil, a shorter wind-up and a slightly smaller paralysis chance - for fast, grinding play.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.growth.0: From level %1$s the Electric power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.growth.1: From level %1$s the Electric power rises to %2$s and the paralysis chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.use.0: Shove a target in your face with an electrified charge
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.use.1: Paralyze a key target that is not paralyzed yet
worldcombat.skill.wildcharge.use.2: Drive current into a target while it is soaked
On: the current runs wide open - power, paralysis chance, knockback and sparks all rise, but the recoil is heavier and the wind-up longer. Off: governed, lower power and recoil, shorter wind-up.
Within this distance the user starts the charge; smaller stays in your face, larger charges from further out.
On: do not spend the charge on an already paralyzed target, save the current for one that is not. Off: compete by the shared order only.
